blocks.text: Water is the foundation of life. It keeps humans alive and healthy through hydration and hygiene, and removes toxic materials from the body. It allows plants to carry out photosynthesis and supports agriculture by enabling crops to grow. Animals rely on it to regulate body functions, and countless microorganisms depend on it to survive. Human development, agriculture and food security all depend on a steady supply of water.

In nature, water shapes the land, keeps the climate balanced and recharges underground reservoirs. Ecosystems such as rivers, lakes, wetlands and oceans rely on water to support diverse plant and animal life. Water is vital for energy production, transport, urban development and scientific research, and water scarcity threatens the environment, communities and economies.
